reviews.name: Isabelle Adler
reviews.text: The best ever, seriously!!! I have done multiple trips with SYB and the most recent was fantastic as ever. We had a great time in the Dolomites - hikes were challenging but doable. Then, Lake Garda was fabulous and so refreshing. Thank you to the leaders for doing a great job!

reviews.name: Fahim Falzada
reviews.text: I did the Iceland (fire & ice) trip with some of the most amazing people around. The trip was fantastic and the itinerary was full of surprises. From incredible hikes in the mountains to chasing waterfalls and relaxing in hot springs, there is nothing else like it. It is truly a blessing to have professionals plan the entire trip, so that I could turn off my mind and simply enjoy being present. I was in good company with the leaders, who organized and worked hard around the clock to make sure we all had an excellent experience. It takes a lot of work and skill to run these trips and the leaders at SYB are absolute pros who are dedicated to the craft. Look no further; this is it. You will remember your experience forever and might get hooked to go again and again. Thank you SYB for making the world a better place!

reviews.name: Samantha Donovan
reviews.text: What an absolutely amazing trip!!! I just returned from Iceland and it was a trip of a lifetime. We were spoiled with the sunshine, rainbows, hikes, workouts, puffins, northern lights and most important the best people. Eli, Christian and Meag as leaders made the experience even better. Each day they were hyping us up for our adventure, leading the way, capturing the most beautiful photos. Highly recommend the three of them as your next leaders! Thanks SYB - can’t wait for the next trip!

reviews.name: Sierra Vigna
reviews.text:
UPDATE: Travelled for a third time with SYB to Iceland and it was the best decision I ever made. My favourite thing about these trips is that I book it and don't have to think twice about itinerary or planning for a second - I just show up and SYB shows me the time of my life. Meag, Christian and Eli - the amazing leaders who show up for everyone and really are the glue that holds the whole thing together - thank you SO MUCH for all of your effort and for being incredible humans and guiding us through this unbelievable trip. I'll probably have to edit this review again in a few months because I'm not done travelling with SYB!

Just came back from my second trip with SYB - the Nicaragua trip was incredibly fun and I felt zero stress the entire time I was there. Holly, Matas and Luke were the coolest leaders and kept everything organized while also having a blast alongside our group. 10/10 recommend traveling this way - good for the soul. 🩷

reviews.name: Ryan Pitts
reviews.text:
My SYB Iceland trip was an absolutely unforgettable experience! From start to finish, the trip was filled with great vibes, amazing people, and incredible experiences.

A huge shoutout to our leaders Meag, Christian, and Eli for making the trip so special. They brought such great energy, made everyone feel included, and did an awesome job keeping the group connected and having fun. You could tell they genuinely cared about everyone having a great experience.

The itinerary was incredible — we got to see some of the most beautiful landscapes Iceland has to offer, experience the Northern Lights, take amazing photos, do a cold plunge, and somehow even fit in fun and games, trampolines, and plenty of laughs along the way. There was always something going on, but it never felt overwhelming.

The combination of the scenery, adventures, people, and overall atmosphere made this trip something I’ll remember for a long time. I came home with some incredible photos and even better memories.

10/10 would do it again. If you’re thinking about booking an SYB trip, do it!

reviews.name: Bart Fuchs
reviews.text: Best group travel around. If you want to not worry about where to go while traveling join this amazing group. My trip to Iceland would not have been half as fun and rewarding if not for these amazing people leading the way and taking us to the best hiking spots and hot springs in record time. If you want to travel and get stuff done in a short amount of time while making incredible friends along the way, it’s worth the money. Take the leap!!

reviews.name: Amber S.
reviews.text:
Just completed my 1st SYB trip in Iceland, and it'll be a tough one to beat! I’ve traveled solo and abroad with friends, but this was my first time joining group travel. I wasn’t totally sure what to expect going in, but the experience exceeded my expectations. Everyone was so friendly and welcoming, and I genuinely couldn’t have asked for a better group.

Our leaders, Meag, Christian, and Eli, were the perfect mix of fun, energetic, and encouraging. They kept us motivated, grounded when needed, and laughing throughout the trip.

We somehow managed to get incredible weather all week! The hikes were challenging, the views were UNREAL, and we even got a little Northern Lights action. I came home with a shorter bucket list, and made some unforgettable memories along the way.

The accommodations were clean, comfortable, convenient, and the whole trip was well organized.

I’d absolutely recommend SYB to anyone looking to see the world, push themselves a little, and connect with some awesome people along the way. I’m already looking forward to my next adventure and hope to maybe run into some familiar faces!

reviews.name: Kelsey Rudzinsky
reviews.text:
I just got back from my first SYB trip, I went to Iceland. Truly, a 10/10 trip. This company is the real deal. I felt safe, supported, and excited for more the entire week. Eli was the trip leader and he is one of the most wonderful humans I have met! Eli, Meag, and Christian were the perfect balance and it was clear they put so much energy and intention into making the entire week as incredible as it was.

As someone who doesn’t really drink, I was nervous going in that I’d feel left out. I didn’t. The people who go on these trips are definitely the work hard, play hard type- but they are welcoming and accepting of all. The physicality of the trip exceeded my expectations. I felt pushed and challenged by the hikes. The accommodations were clean and safe- and it was really fun to share a room with 6 people- it felt like being at summer camp.

I definitely plan on doing another SYB trip, and if you’re looking for a fun group trip to go on- I recommend this company for sure!

reviews.name: Claire Hanrahan
reviews.text:
Don’t think just do - the vibe of the trip and I couldn’t agree more!
I had followed SYB on social media for a little while and after a call with their founder Mantas I booked my first SYB trip to Iceland. I wanted to see the real Iceland and not just drive to the typical tourist spots and that’s what exactly this trip allowed.
I was a little hesitant as I was coming from Australia, the furthest I had ever been from home and it was so cold. However once I met the crew I knew this was exactly where I should be.
Whilst I don’t surf, do much yoga or drink beer( love champagne and wine) I loved what this trip stood for which was we exercised hard but also partied hard! Everyone was there for a good time!
I had the most incredible leaders Bradford, Elena, Ken and Chuko who made sure this trip was an unforgettable experience and were always so warm and welcoming. It wouldn’t have been the same without them. The crew was also so much fun and we had a ball.
Not sure I can go back to Iceland now as I don’t think I’d ever be able to top this experience. So book that trip as you won’t regret it.
Claire (Australia)

Turkish Riviera ⛵️🇹🇷

What a week! We were so lucky to have Eli and Nikki as our SYB leaders. They were both amazing and honestly made the trip what it was.

Eli brought the  adventure every day — from hiking and watersports to jumping off the boat, exploring and plenty of laughs along the way. Nikki’s yoga and meditation sessions were the perfect balance and a great way to slow down after a big day.

They were both so easy-going, encouraging and genuinely fun to be around. Nothing ever felt forced and, because we were such a small group, it felt like we all became friends really quickly.

There were so many laughs, a lot of drinks, plenty of adventures and memories I’ll be talking about for a long time. I also loved watching the way they led the group — calm, inclusive, encouraging and always making everyone feel comfortable. Definitely some leadership qualities I’ll be taking home with me!

Couldn’t have asked for better leaders. Thanks for such an incredible week, Eli and Nikki — you guys were the best! ❤️🍾

reviews.name: Ashley Anderson
reviews.text:
This was my fourth Surf Yoga Beer trip, and it was hands down my best one yet. Türkiye and the Turkish Riviera were spectacular, but Nikki R. and Eli Elmore were what made this experience truly exceptional.

This was my second trip with Eli, and he is by far my favorite leader to travel with. He has an innate ability to lead with confidence while remaining thoughtful, approachable and deeply respectful of everyone around him. His conviction in the way he lives, his ability to bring people together and his willingness to extend grace when it is needed set him apart. He creates an environment where people feel supported, included and encouraged to become the best versions of themselves. Eli alone makes any experience ten times better, regardless of the destination, and I would travel anywhere with him as a leader.

Nikki brought an entirely different and equally valuable energy to the trip. She made everything more fun while also having a remarkable ability to make everyone feel comfortable being completely themselves. From creating TikTok music videos and laughing over the smallest things to having meaningful one-on-one conversations, she knew exactly when to bring the energy and when to slow down and genuinely connect.

Nikki was also one of the best yoga instructors I have ever practiced with. Meditation and journaling have always been difficult for me, but her guidance made both feel natural, accessible and meaningful. She leads with kindness, and that kindness speaks volumes. Nothing about her approach felt forced or performative. She created a safe space that allowed people to open up, reflect and participate at their own pace.

Together, Eli and Nikki created the perfect balance of adventure, structure, laughter, reflection and genuine connection. They made every person feel seen and brought out something special in the entire group. I would enthusiastically book another trip led by either of them and would be especially excited to travel with them together again.

This was more than an incredible vacation. It was a life changing experience, and Nikki and Eli were a huge reason why.

reviews.name: Elvis
reviews.text: SYB Iceland (Iceland North, Twice the Ice) was incredible! The hikes they chose had spectacular scenery while also delivering on being physically challenging enough to make you feel like you truly accomplished something when reaching a summit. The trip was meticulously researched by the guides - they knew the hikes and logistics, and just as important, they knew where to go for the best meals and lagoons (hot springs). As if all of that weren’t enough, there were these special moments of guided reflection as well (mental yoga!) that deepened the experience even further. Highly recommend this.

reviews.name: Lyndsay Hern
reviews.text:
My husband and I just returned from Surf Yoga Beer’s first Côte d’Azur, French Riviera trip, and we honestly can’t say enough good things about the experience.

We originally booked this trip to support our longtime friend Erin, one of the trip leaders. Going into it, we really didn’t know what to expect. We knew these types of group travel experiences tend to attract more solo (and often single) travelers, so as a couple we weren’t sure how we’d fit in.

From the moment we arrived, every single one of the people on the trip made us feel welcomed, included, and genuinely loved. By the end of the week, it felt like we had gained an entire new group of friends.

The itinerary was definitely go, go, go! If we had one small piece of feedback, it would be to build in a little more downtime at some beaches to relax and soak it all in. That said, we’re both very active and social people, so we loved how much we were able to experience.

Our welcome dinner the first night in Cassis was incredible—a family-style seafood feast with so many amazing dishes to try.

The kayaking adventure through the Calanques was one of our favorite experiences. We had never been kayaking before, and now we can’t wait to do it again. The scenery was absolutely breathtaking.

In Castellane at Verdon Gorge, we went canyoning for the first time. We’ve floated the American River before, so we thought we knew what to expect…we were very wrong! It was much more adventurous than anticipated, but so much fun. Our guide did an incredible job making everyone feel safe and comfortable throughout the experience. I may have been shivering for the entire hour and a half because the water was freezing (LOL), but it was absolutely worth it.

The lavender field photo shoot was another unforgettable highlight. Even though we had some crazy wind, the fields were stunning, and Matas somehow managed to capture absolutely gorgeous photos despite the conditions.

Our bike tour through Saint-Tropez was another favorite. We only wish we had more time to explore the town because we completely fell in love with it. Between the beautiful beaches, an amazing lunch, and winery visit, it was an incredible day that ended with an amazing group dinner at Crazy Pizza.

The four leaders absolutely made this trip what it was. Erin has been one of my best friends since high school, so I already knew how amazing she is. But watching her lead a large group was incredible. Whether she was leading a killer morning yoga session, planning an unforgettable SHELLONA beach club day (which was one of the highlights of the trip, and for being a “free night” all 27 of us went and it was worth the cost!), or being the first one ready to celebrate and have fun at night, she brought such an authentic, positive energy that made everyone want to have fun.

Christian was pure positivity from start to finish. His energy is genuinely contagious. From 7 a.m. workouts to turning every bus ride into a dance party, he had everyone laughing, singing, and smiling. He has a way of making every single person feel included, and that kind of leadership is something special.

Matas was our incredible photographer, and we are so grateful he was there to capture memories we’ll have forever. Beyond his talent behind the camera, he’s one of the most genuine, down-to-earth people we’ve met. It was awesome getting to know him when he wasn’t busy documenting the adventure.

Holly was equally amazing. She constantly made an effort to connect with everyone, made people feel welcome, and led some fun workouts. Her encouragement and chill vibes never went unnoticed.

If you ever have the opportunity to join a trip with Erin, Holly, Christian, and Matas, consider yourself lucky. They created an environment where complete strangers became friends and where everyone truly felt like they belonged.

This was our first Surf Yoga Beer trip, and it absolutely won’t be our last. We have nothing else to compare it to, but if this is the standard, we can’t wait to book another adventure.

If you’re on the fence, don’t overthink it.

reviews.name: Stephanie Neville
reviews.text: I had an absolutely unforgettable experience on the Surf Yoga Beer Kenya trip from start to finish. The views across the Maasai Mara were beyond anything I could have imagined, and the hot air balloon safari was a true highlight—watching the sunrise over the savannah, spotting wildlife from above, and then enjoying a gourmet breakfast out in the middle of the wilderness was an unforgettable experience. A huge thank you to our amazing guides, Eli and Bri, who went above and beyond every single day. Their knowledge, positivity, and incredible energy made every game drive and every moment even more enjoyable, and it was clear how much they genuinely cared about giving us the best possible experience. Everything was exceptionally well organized, and I felt taken care of throughout the entire trip. If you’re considering a Surf Yoga Beer adventure, don’t hesitate—it was truly the trip of a lifetime, and I couldn’t recommend it more highly.

reviews.name: Timothy Dunn
reviews.text:
My first Surf Yoga Beer trip was Iceland in 2025, and since then I’ve been back again and again: Croatia, the Dolomites, Val Thorens, the Amalfi Coast, and the South of France. I think that says more than any review ever could.

Every trip has been completely different, but one thing has remained consistent: exceptional people, outstanding leadership, and experiences that exceed every expectation. Mantas, Bradford, Eli, Steph, and the entire SYB team have built something that’s incredibly difficult to replicate. They don’t just organize trips—they create an environment where strangers quickly become friends and unforgettable memories happen naturally.

The itineraries are always excellent, but they’re honestly the least important part of the experience. What makes Surf Yoga Beer special is the community. The people you meet, the friendships you build, and the moments that happen between the planned activities are what keep me coming back.

After six trips, I can confidently say this is one of the best decisions I’ve ever made for travel. If you’re on the fence, stop overthinking it. Book the trip. You’ll understand why so many people come back year after year.

reviews.name: Begum Taskazan
reviews.text: I did their signature Nicaragua trip with them as a solo female traveler. I was nervous since I haven’t travelled solo before, but all guides were super welcoming, so is the other SYBers. This trip was exactly what I was looking for: social and active!

reviews.name: Sara MacKay
reviews.text:
It’s been a couple years since I went to Nicaragua with Surf Yoga Beer, and it’s still one of the best trips I’ve ever taken. It completely changed what I look for when I travel. I stopped caring about checking boxes and started chasing experiences, adventure, and the kinds of people who make you laugh until your abs hurt.

I still keep in touch with friends from that trip, and I somehow keep running into them in random corners of the world—which feels very on-brand for SYB.

If you’re on the fence because of the cost or because taking time off work feels impossible, let me save you some time: future you is already rolling their eyes. Book the trip.

The Nicaragua setup is unreal. I still dream about the breakfasts before heading out to surf, the sunset horseback rides on the beach, and evening yoga overlooking the ocean after a full day of getting salty and sunburned in the best way possible.

Surf Yoga Beer somehow attracts the kind of people who say yes to adventures, cheer each other on, and become lifelong friends after just a week together. The world feels a whole lot smaller after an SYB trip…and a whole lot more fun.

Zero regrets. Only one complaint: every vacation since has had impossibly big shoes to fill.

reviews.name: Joe Gansky
reviews.text: I just got back from the Kenya trip, and it was an incredible experience with our group leaders Eli and Brianna. They made every day memorable, so If you’re thinking about booking a trip, make sure you go with Eli and Brianna. You wont regret it!

reviews.name: Amy Rivera
reviews.text: Just got back from the Amalfi trip and WHAT A DREAM not just bc of the beautiful places we got to see but for the people I met, true friendships were formed and our leaders Sam Nikki Carrie and Adam were just amazing always looking out for us but also vibing with us and hiping us up the hole time probably see you in Nicaragua on NYE

reviews.name: Cole Untiedt
reviews.text: SYB has the best active, group travel in the game! Just book it and go, they cover ALLLL the details. I recently traveled with them to Belize and it was amazing! Great, curated group of individuals and nice accommodations. Some highlights of the trip included the neon yoga, along with swimming with local nurse sharks. If you are seeking an active, action packed trip - look no further! 🌴

reviews.name: Ami Sidhu
reviews.text: Just got back from the SYB amalfi trip and can honestly say it was the best trip I’ve ever been on. I came solo and really did not know what to expect but I made the most amazing memories and left with lifelong friends. The trip was really well organized and everyone was super friendly and welcoming. I am already thinking about what syb trip to book next.

reviews.name: Jeff Paadre
reviews.text:
5/5 stars, if you're debating it, just do it! The trip we took to Morocco was life-changing! The trip provided a great blend of city (Marrakech), desert (Agafay), and beach (Taghazout). We were able to take in a variety of experiences in such a short time. Logistics were completely taken care of; we got to show up and just enjoy a new country!

A big shoutout to our leaders: Sarah and Matas! They brought the vibes and helped a group of strangers instantly connect with one another.

I'll strongly consider taking another SYB trip ESPECIALLY if either of the two of them are leading!

reviews.name: laimis bucnius
reviews.text: Amazing time guaranteed ! This company will take care of everything from activities to meals and all you have to worry about is bring good vibes and enjoy the adventures! Can’t wait to do it again 🥳

reviews.name: Michelle Henry
reviews.text:
I did the surf yoga beer egypt trip. It was a phenomenal trip! Everything was planned out once you arrived that it was easy to turn off your brain to relax and enjoy the adventure! It was super action packed with great workouts and yoga, tons of cool history lessons! We ended 8 days on a yacht! Going kite surfing, scuba diving, swimming, beach workouts and beach games! This was easily one of the best trips i have ever been on!
The people on the trip were amazing, everyone had so much fun! Late night parties and dancing! The leaders were even better, continuing to bring the great vibes through out the whole trip! It was the perfect amount of relaxation with working out and adventure!
10/10 recommend a trip with SYB!!!! Best group travel there is! Definitely will be looking for another trip in the near future!

reviews.name: Tommy Whitlow
reviews.text: I just got back from the Egypt SYB trip, and it was absolutely incredible! I couldn’t have asked for a better way to explore Egypt. SYB truly outdid themselves with every detail, from visiting iconic temples to riding ATVs, cruising the Red Sea on a massive yacht, kitesurfing, and diving in some of the world’s most famous spots. Everything was planned and executed flawlessly, and it exceeded my expectations in every way. I give SYB a 10/10. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Camrick Clark
reviews.text:
SurfYogaBeer Egypt: 10 days, but it felt like three weeks of adventure.
I went into this trip with high hopes and somehow it still exceeded them. We saw ancient temples, ripped around on quads, scuba dove the Red Sea, and I even learned to kiteboard from scratch. Every day was packed, but it never felt rushed. Just one unforgettable thing after another.
What made it work was the people. The group came together fast and the leaders were the real difference. They were great at literally everything: organized, fun, genuinely good at the activities, and always making sure everyone was having a good time.
If you're on the fence about an SYB trip, this is your sign. I left with new skills, new friends, and a stack of memories I'll be telling stories about for years.

reviews.name: V
reviews.text:
WOW! This review is specifically for the classic Nicaragua trip. I went on my first SYB trip last month. What an incredible trip! Really appreciated how SYB takes care of basically everything after you arrive in Nicaragua.
The resort that SYB hosts at is GORGEOUS and I won't be able to do a proper job describing it, but trust me, it is insanely beautiful. I did the shared room and it was really spacious. They hired a chef for our group for the week and I am still missing their breakfasts.
Our two guides kept the atmosphere super fun, organized, and very exciting but no one forced us to participate, which I thought was really nice.
Remember to bring small bills ($1 and $5) to help tip all of the wonderful staff, drivers, and cooks! All in all a great trip.

reviews.name: Colleen Evans
reviews.text: Just got back from SYB Egypt and I had an amazing time!  This was my first trip and the leaders made me feel welcome from the beginning.  The other travelers were also friendly and welcoming. I’ve done group tours before but getting a chance to try adventurous activities such as scuba diving for the first time made this trip a memorable one.   I was nervous about a trip with scheduled workouts as I have some lingering injuries but I appreciated the fact that nothing was ever mandatory. The workouts wound up being a highlight for me as well as we got to do different things each day such as beach yoga and volleyball. Already have trip #2 booked.

reviews.name: Jeniffer Miranda
reviews.text:
I don’t say this lightly - my Surf Yoga Beer trip to the Philippines was unlike anything I’ve ever experienced!  That’s saying a lot, even compared to other SYB trips I’ve been on.
Palawan is truly a hidden gem, it’s one of those places you don’t even realize is missing from your bucket list until you’re there, completely in awe.  The experience with TAO, and the incredible TAO boys, made it even more special.  They took care of everything from navigating the boat expedition to setting up our beach huts to sleep in each night and of course keeping us well fed with delicious, freshly made meals (and plenty of jungle juice).  Their local knowledge, high energy, and ability to create fun out of every moment took the whole adventure to another level.
What really made this trip unforgettable though were our leaders, Lizzie and Ryan.  You could feel how much intention they put into curating an experience that fostered genuine connection.  The nature of the trip already sets the stage with no cell service, no distractions, stripped down from the “real world” (goodbye makeup and hot showers), and instead you’re placed on remote, breathtaking beaches surrounded by incredible people.  Yet somehow Lizzie and Ryan elevated it even more.  Their excitement for leading workouts, sunset yoga, mindful moments, and themed parties was contagious.  They created a space where everyone felt comfortable being their most authentic selves, something that seems rare these days.  Also, a special shoutout to Ryan for capturing everyone’s best moments through candid photos, I’m talking frame-worthy memories from the trip of a lifetime.
This may not be SYB’s most well-known trip but honestly, it should be!  It perfectly balances movement, adventure, and meaningful social connection in a setting that feels almost unreal.  You leave not just with memories, but with a true sense of belonging, to nature, to the people you met, and to the SYB community as a whole.
If you weren’t considering this trip before, I hope you are now… and if you need one more reason here it is: Lizzie is leading this trip again in 2027!  Don’t miss it.

reviews.name: michel dawson
reviews.text: Words can't truly capture how incredible the people, leaders, and experiences with SYB are.  If you're even slightly interested - Don't Think Just Do!

reviews.name: Ariel Hernandez
reviews.text: Egypt was never one of those places that was on my bucket list, but the universe decided to pull me in that direction and I couldn't turn down the opportunity. It was a fun filled and adventure packed week, and no better way to experience this part of the world than with strangers who become good friends while having type 2 fun in and around the water!! I wouldn't have done a trip to this region of the world any other way! SYB has become apart of making travel simple and a way to build meaningful connections with people who have similar interests that I wouldn't otherwise have had a chance to get to know. I wholeheartedly believe that if you're living your life on standby, waiting for your friends or "the right time" to do something... You'll continue to live an unfulfilled and dull life, and I would HIGHLY encourage you to embrace the "Don't Think, Just Do" lifestyle. Take the risk. Book that next trip.

reviews.name: Hannah Kerin
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely amazing experience with Surf Yoga Beer Bali. This trip exceeded every expectation — I met 25 incredible people who quickly became friends, and the entire vibe was fun, welcoming, and unforgettable.

The itinerary was packed with once-in-a-lifetime experiences. The boat day was a highlight — snorkeling alongside manta rays and sea turtles was surreal. We also went ATV riding and white water rafting through the jungle, which was such an adrenaline rush. Nights out at Finns were a blast, and yes… plenty of tequila involved 🍹

I loved that the trip balanced adventure with wellness. The Pilates class and athletic conditioning sessions were great, and of course, surfing was such a fun challenge and a huge highlight.

Everything was so well organized, and the mix of activities made it the perfect blend of adventure, fitness, and social fun. I would 100% recommend this trip to anyone looking for a unique, active, and social travel experience — I’m already thinking about the next one!

reviews.name: ry al
reviews.text: My second SYB trip and looking forward to my third, all within one year. There’s no better and easier way to take a vacation with so many like minded people. All of the leaders guide you and make you feel like home.

reviews.name: Luke Harris
reviews.text: Surf camp Nicaragua was fantastic!  Rob and Carri did a great job organizing events but also changed plans to adapt specifically for our group. Great surf instructors, equipment and waves! Will definitely try and join another trip soon. If you’re on the fence just go for it!

reviews.name: Brayden Scott
reviews.text:
SYB Philippines - Incredible setup and Philippines is a very picturesque location, the Palawan islands are a bit of a hidden gem.

The 6 day boat tour with the Tao foundation and the lost boys is the best one I’ve been on, food freshly cooked along the way, freshly made bed each night, sleeping in a hut each night next to the beach, snorkel stops along the way and even some beach volleyball, the lost boys are there with you for everything making sure everyone is safe and having as much fun as possible.

Leaders- Ryan and Lizzie were part of the group but made sure every single person was involved along the way. Lizzie’s workouts and yoga sessions made me enjoy group workouts which I didn’t think was possible. Ryan’s photos and videos were awesome and all photos ready by end of trip. He captured the whole experience but was involved all the way through. A couple of great leaders and would make me look at booking the same trip again if they were leaders.

reviews.name: Sara Balaban
reviews.text:
I just got back from SYB's Palawan, Philippines Island-hopping adventure, and out of the 7 SYB trips I've taken so far, this one just snagged my number 1 spot. The Philippines with SYB feels like a secret people desperately need to know about. First off, leaders Lizzie and Ryan were phenomenal, and the smaller group allowed for deep connections and community, something we are all craving. Even better? No cell service for 5 days, was the gift I had been yearning for. I was able to be present and appreciate the beautiful surroundings and real-time conversations with really awesome people. Sleeping in beach huts was an amazing experience, and considering we were sleeping mostly on private island with just our group, the bathroom situation was totally fine. (coming from a girl living in the upper east side of NYC).  Honestly, it was so freeing not worrying about what I was wearing or how my hair looked, because we were living in swim suits and in the ocean all day snorkeling, kayaking, or getting sandy during yoga and beach workouts. This trip is the epitome of a 'primal reset," - everything that SurfYogaBeer stands for: community, wellness, connection, mindfulness. If you need a digital detox, love boat days, the ocean, the freshest organic food, beach games, dancing under the stars, and want to experience the best trip of your life....SurfYogaBeer Philippines is a MUST!

PS: we had a jack russell puppy on our boat for the week, which was a HUGE added bonus.

reviews.name: Cole Untiedt
reviews.text: Surf Yoga Beer is the best group travel out there! Everything is handled and communicated to you ahead of time, and you are introduced to the group. My trip with them to the Philippines was a complete delight, and it was certainly an elevated experience which I could not have experienced with any other group or company. All there leaders are accomplished, and make the trip an experience you will want to come back for! 🏄🏽‍♂️

reviews.name: Heather Wohaska
reviews.text:
UPDATE! I recently went to Nicaragua (with a much smaller crew than Croatia) so I have the luck of sharing perspectives from both. I loved Nica so much. The villas were truly magical 24/7. The workouts were amazing, shout out to Jenny for leading us day and night with different programs that left me feeling so accomplished. I loved that we had multiple days of surf lessons to practice or catch-up on the beach with new friends. Being in my 30s, I usually feel hesitant to join group trips like this, but I felt our dynamic was perfect with the diverse age range and mix of activities where every night didn't have to be a party if you wanted to catch the sunrise together the next day. You can also feel how integrated SYB is in this beach community and it makes you feel right at home. I felt relaxed yet fulfilled with health and fitness. 10/10 would recommend.

SYB Croatia 2024: I'm really happy I booked a solo trip with SYB to Croatia! I loved the daily workouts/yoga before heading off to local adventures like hiking, biking, and kayaking. Mantas and Steph fostered a culture of fun while pushing your limits for personal growth with a group of strangers that quickly become friends from all over the world. I would definitely recommend.

reviews.name: Austin Caldwell
reviews.text:
It’s not easy to describe the SYB Japan trip I just took, but to do so in one sentence is to say that it truly is lightening in a bottle - and something I definitely will keep with me my entire life.

I’d been a follower of SYB on Instagram for quite some time & finally decided to book my first by jumping on the ski trip to Japan, which was the second time it was run - but I truly would have never guessed. The execution of logistics, for starters, is unparalleled. Our trip leader, Sarah, left no detail unturned. From karaoke nights in Golden Gai in Tokyo, incredible museum visits at TeamLabs, to navigating the insane terrain of Niseko (on the mountain and in the town) - Sarah is a planning (& execution!) queen! Also - she’s just an all around badass - A+++ trip leader.

The destination & logistics are of course a big part of any SYB trip, but the real magic is in the people. From the welcome dinner, I felt immediate connections to people who I know I’ll call friends for life. People I cried to, people who picked me up (literally) when I fell in 5+ feet of powder, people who leaned in & also gave space for others on the trip, and people who were equally as okay with a long night out or a night in playing cards before an early morning of shredding - this all happened for me across the trip.

Book an SYB trip. It’s your best chance at capturing lightening in a bottle. Your only regret will be not booking one sooner.

reviews.name: Adam Jubert
reviews.text: This was my first trip with SurfYogaBeer and I’m already planning my next one. Every day in Nicaragua was full of fun, adventure, and laughter: the whole group loved the morning workouts, home cooked meals, surfing, sunset yoga, and various surprises throughout the week. Major shout out to Kaia’s leadership: she made everything feel seamless and her positivity was contagious. And shout out to Brycen for taking some amazing photos while always making the group laugh! I joined the group solo and left with lifelong friends, and I can’t thank SYB enough for that.

reviews.name: Fabian Sanchez
reviews.text: I had an amazing time in SYB Nicaragua.  Everyday was full of fun activities.  The weather was amazing and the location was wonderful with spectacular views.  Jenny did a great job of leading the fun, yet challenging workouts.  Kaia and Brycen were great at organizing the activities and capturing every moment of the great memories that we made.  This was my first SYB and I was a little hesitant to book at first since I am in my late 40s.  I was pleasantly surprised to see many people of different age groups and how well everyone got along.  This trip exceeded all of my expectations and I would highly recommend any one of any age to book.
